newsitem.title: GERMANY: German 1997 federal deficit seen at 71.2 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: German 1997 federal deficit seen at 71.2 bln DM.

text.p: Finance Minister Theo Waigel's draft budget and finance planning now foresees Germany's federal deficit climbing to 71.2 billion marks this year before falling back to 57.8 billion marks in 1998, according to documents obtained by Reuters.
The federal deficit is seen at 57.6 billion marks in 1999, 53.4 billion marks in 2000, and 47.0 billion marks in 2001, the documents show.
Federal outlays are seen at 458.6 billion marks in 1997 and 461.0 billion marks in 1998.
The Labour Ministry budget is the largest for 1997 at 149 billion marks, up 21.3 billion marks due to higher unemployment costs. That figure is seen at 147 billion marks for 1998.
The construction budget is also rising due to the government's planned move to Berlin.
